blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Forests help keep water flowing to communities, particularly during prolonged dry spells. As El Niño recurs every few years, the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) is expanding forest protection patrols and accelerating targeted reforestation across critical watersheds nationwide to help forests retain water, regulate streamflow, reduce soil erosion and recharge depleted aquifers. The effort combines the restoration of degraded and fire-damaged areas with measures to ensure the survival of newly planted trees and protect existing forests.
